title: BrushOff: Stroke-Based Re-rendering as a Watermark Removal Attack on Paintings
venue: arXiv preprint; final venue not independently verified
limitations: Painting domain only, one renderer, fixed payload and outcome-selected operating-point discussion. Nominal binomial FPR assumes fair independent null bits; 0/500 is not empirical proof of 1e-3. Borrowing VINE fidelity for other marks is a pilot-based assumption. The reported 27 seconds per 2048-canvas image on an unnamed consumer GPU is not our cost estimate. Probe decoder changed after clean failure and is exploratory.
